title: Autoantibodies in Patients With Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus
brief_summary: Evaluate the autoantibodies, such as glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD65), tyrosine phosphatase (IA-2 or ICA125), islet autoantibodies (IAA) and other associated autoimmune autoantibodies: microsomal antibodies, thyroglobulin antibodies, gastric parietal cell antibodies in patients with type 1 DM.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* pediatric patients with type 1 diabetes
